variant: 1 Pool left-of-center, a softly rounded kidney shape whose open concavity faces the lower-right fishing beach. Two palms at upper-left shore and one well away near upper-middle; low layered rock resting ledge to right, casting its shadow on sand. Bottom half broad open sandy approach. Show wet shoreline and restful shade without crowding the water.

2 Pool upper-right-of-center, irregular horizontal oval with a short shallow sand tongue extending inward at its near-left shore. All three palms form a loose upper-right group, far behind fishing spot. Low sandstone shade ledge on left. Broad diagonal sandy approach from lower-left opens into entire near shore, but no drawn road. Generous lower and left open sand.

3 Pool centered a little above middle, broad crescent-like natural pond around a small curved dry sandy bay at bottom center; bay is continuous with open foreground, NOT an island. Two palms above-left and one above-right frame it loosely. A single flat low rock ledge at far left is a quiet resting spot. Broad clear near bay for fishing, no bridge or built structures.

4 Pool slightly left of center, asymmetrical teardrop pond with broad shallow southern edge and narrower north-east tip. Three palms in loose cluster on upper-left dry bank and a low flat rock resting shelf upper-right, offset from water. Open sandy circuit along right and below. Broad smooth fishing beach at lower-right of pond, very sparse reeds at far tip. Maintain dry desert dominance.
